Summary of the Goal The user (acting as a Genius Editor/Admin) accessed the administrative controls for the song "To the Light", awarded transcription IQ points to the user who transcribed the song's lyrics, confirmed the action via the browser popup, and reopened the menu to confirm the button state successfully toggled to "Remove transcription IQ". Part 1: Relating the Video Action to the HAR Network Payload When you clicked "Award transcription IQ" and confirmed the prompt, your browser dispatched an authenticated request to Genius's backend. The HTTP Request Method: POST (or PUT depending on Rails/API routing) Endpoint: https://genius.com/songs/{song_id}/award_transcription_iq (or /api/songs/{song_id}/transcription_iq) Headers required in the HAR: Host: genius.com User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 ... Accept: application/json, text/javascript, /; q=0.01 Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8 X-CSRF-Token: [EXTRACTED_CSRF_TOKEN] X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest Origin: https://genius.com Referer: https://genius.com/Peacestar-to-the-light-lyrics Cookie: _genius_session=...; __cf_bm=...; ... Payload: { "id": 1234567, "authenticity_token": "[EXTRACTED_CSRF_TOKEN]" } The State Check (Before vs. After) Before Awarding: The song's page data contains transcription_iq_awarded: false (or the DOM menu renders Award transcription IQ). “Obsessed” by Clema is a a soulful Afrobeat confession blending smooth melodies with heartfelt devotion.

\n\n
This track has a story: first teased by Clema in 2024 over a viral song titled “Reason” by Omah Lay (which didn’t go anywhere), then reimagined as a cover around December 2024, gaining underground buzz. In February 2025, Clema teased Obsessed as a full song — now it’s finally here and doing numbers across Africa and beyond.
